core.headline: First-floor flat with lift and Juliet balcony, Chatham ME4
core.listing:
A first-floor purpose-built flat in Chatham with a lift and an allocated parking space. The property offers open-plan living and a Juliet balcony.

The open-plan kitchen/living room provides the main living space and features a Juliet balcony. There are two bedrooms and one bathroom. The flat is on the first floor and benefits from lift access.

Outside, there is one allocated parking space.

The property is in Chatham, close to New Road.

Guide Price £195,000. Leasehold with 99 years remaining and a service charge of £1,450 per year (year ending March 2026). Council Tax Band B (Medway Council). EPC rating C. Mains electricity, mains water (metered), mains sewerage and gas central heating. FTTC broadband available and good outdoor mobile signal coverage on major networks. Building safety, restrictions, rights and easements, flooding, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield or mining issues are all none known.
core.summary: First-floor purpose-built flat in Chatham with lift, Juliet balcony and allocated parking. Open-plan kitchen/living room, two bedrooms and one bathroom. Guide Price £195,000. Leasehold.
